title: Conditional κ = 0.001730970419199163702738 (+1.614e-7 over #4076): receiver sharing on the staged T360 supplier
body:
## Result

**This improves the conditional κ of [#4076](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4076) by 1.61385622611621004 × 10⁻⁷ (+0.0093243%).**
It composes exact dirty receiver sharing with [#4076](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4076)'s three staged helper entries
and literal T360 owner allocation, building on [#3945](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3945)'s terminal refit.

| | [#4076](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4076) | This contribution |
|---|---:|---:|
| Complex root lower endpoint | 0.001730809033576552081734 | **0.001730970419199163702738** |
| Outer loss | 10⁻⁴⁶ + 10⁻⁷⁰ | 10⁻⁴⁶ + 10⁻⁷⁰ |
| Binding supplier | Complex | Complex |

The exact conditional claim is

```
κ = 0.001730970419199163702738 − 10^-46 − 10^-70.
```

Both claims subtract the same outer losses, so the increase in κ is exactly
the increase in the supplier endpoint. The percentage compares the displayed endpoints.

The added receiver identity replaces `672 += 544; 676 -= 544` with
`672 += 676; 676 -= 544; 672 -= 676`, with the required frames and regenerated
cleanup. It preserves arbitrary dirty inputs and changes the local paid profile
by `{1:-1, 2:-1, 3:+1}`. The complete native/owner invoice prices that change.

The submission also supplies exact operator checks that reject the faulty
phase-axis overlay used by the earlier [#3955](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3955)/[#3959](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3959) chain. The new supplier uses
no such overlay. The historical high complex claim remains withdrawn; the
research target 0.001745 remains open.

## Evidence and validation

- The new gate checks 10,416 exact phase identities across all 112 ports,
  including signed controller, final translation and global phase. Its stated
  algebraic scope covers all characters and positive tensor multiplicities
  under the retained local-endpoint interface. The old faulty overlay rejects.
- The stronger owner invoice checks all 1,321,920 hosted rows and 70,876 owner
  reassignments, recovering the original child operators from hosted and
  complementary residual factors.
- A separate exact rational calculation confirms the final complex root bracket,
  rank mass, binding supplier, outer losses and comparison arithmetic.
- Fresh portable replay passed **14 scientific stages and 29 comparisons**
  in 115.20 seconds, including both complete five-stage native providers. Three
  portability rejection controls passed. Fresh receipts and logs are retained.
- All supplied archive bytes are preserved. The submission adds unpacked
  source/evidence trees rather than committing the 168 MB ZIP.

Two local portability issues were identified and documented: the native audit
requires NumPy, and native gzip OS header bytes differ between Linux and macOS.
The new review runner uses the unchanged core and native scientific scripts.
It compares gzip payloads exactly and authenticates each derived receipt's
container digests before comparing every remaining scientific field. It permits
only the documented phase-review runtime difference. The frozen submission
and expected receipts remain unchanged.

```sh
python3.12 -m venv /tmp/kappa-repair-env
/tmp/kappa-repair-env/bin/python -m pip install numpy==2.2.6
/tmp/kappa-repair-env/bin/python -B research/kappa-operator-repair-review/verify.py \
  --out /absolute/path/to/a/fresh-directory
python3.12 -B research/kappa-operator-repair-review/check_price.py
python3.12 -B research/kappa-operator-repair-review/check_import.py --git-ref HEAD
```

The review and fresh evidence live in `research/kappa-operator-repair-review/`.
The authoritative final claim is
`research/kappa-operator-repair/late-staged-composition/CLAIM.json`; the package's
top-level claim is an earlier, weaker checkpoint.

## Scope and attribution

The portable review freshly executes core proofs and both native providers.
It authenticates the retained completed full-release evidence without rerunning
that long release. The retained BIT supplier is also source-bound rather than
freshly executed here. Uniform native/cover embeddings, physical primitives,
compiler/tape costs, precision, recurrence and outer transfer remain conditional.
There is no complete GL64 physical execution, formal-kernel acceptance,
independent human approval, or maintainer admission. The selected frontier stays
unchanged.

Canonical main was refreshed to `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`.
[#3945](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3945) and [#4076](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4076) heads match the supplied pins; related open PRs were checked.
The direct improvement comparison is to the pinned [#4076](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4076) claim.

Credit David Ganz / Dugongue ([#3945](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3945)), Rohan Arun ([#4076](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4076)), Tekalign's native
runner, Ross Richardson, dataisfire, ChaloupeMusic / Erwan Secousses,
Marius-Paul Dumitrean, Sagar Thakrar, roger-sato, the full T360/BIT/outer lineage,
and Nick Petalas, Matarener and Erwan for the earlier operator obstruction.
Original notices are retained. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Open next questions: independent review of the retained full release, admission
of uniform native/owner and precision interfaces, and further gains on the
repaired staged/receiver word with complete invoices.
